verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: a cleanly balanced two-line headline with the badge and centred CTA below it. However, the whole group sits too high, with a tight top margin of about 30px and a dead orange band at the bottom, so it is top-heavy and needs re-centring. B has an unbalanced headline wrap that leaves 'sunshine.' alone on a short second line. Its CTA is pushed off-axis to the right, and the LIMITED badge collides with the button and covers 'See', so the CTA reads 'e the Flavours'. B is broken.
